code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (8,5)]
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    obj=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts]
    anchors=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar,ac in anchors:
        for r,c,v in obj:
            rr,ccc=ar+r-cr,ac+c-cc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=ccc<w: out[rr][ccc]=v
    return out
'''
